product.title: GM Trade Challenge — The 5-Minute Decision Maker
product.summary: Timed trade calls across escalating difficulty tiers.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students work three rounds per difficulty level against a countdown, choosing among trade packages that trade certainty for upside, with a running score across levels.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Three difficulty tiers with real information asymmetry — surplus and window are hidden behind question marks at higher levels — and a timer that tightens from 90 to 45 seconds. Two strategies produced genuinely different endings: always trading up cleared all three levels at 8.3, always taking the star swing failed level two at 5.3 with total surplus -5.
knownBlockers: The strongest option is listed first and looks the same every round, so a student can pattern-click the first card without reading the EV numbers. Shuffling option order would force the reading the lesson depends on.

curation.tierBasis: Explicit EV, surplus and window numbers with real information asymmetry at higher tiers and a tightening clock. Divergent endings confirmed.

provenance.evidence: 201-M4-L3/index.html defines levels with per-level timers (e.g. 'Rookie GM', timer 90) and three rounds each. The title's '5-Minute' refers to decision pacing, not session length, so no duration is recorded.
